topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Hey, I just stumbled across this list, and I can't shake the thought that maybe I should have known all these things you wanted to do. It feels like a secret part of you I only just discovered. I wonder if there's something I missed, something I could have been a part of all along. Maybe we can talk about it, go over some of the things you’ve always wanted to try. I’m here, you know, and I want to be the one to help you cross these off, one by one. What do you think?
